description: Create blog.html — the public blog listing page. Structure copied from shop.html (same nav, announcement topbar, footer, cart drawer, mobile menu, search overlay). Page-specific content: hero section for featured post, category filter tabs (from Supabase blog_categories), search input, 4-column responsive grid of blog cards, Load More button (9 posts per page), and empty state. Depends on FEAT-002 nav changes being in place (blog.html includes the Blog nav item as active).
steps: Copy the full <head> block from shop.html (fonts, meta, viewport). Change <title> to 'Blog | AERA'.
Copy the full CSS <style> block from shop.html into blog.html. Append the blog-specific CSS rules listed below.
Copy the announcement topbar HTML (div.topbar) from shop.html verbatim.

Copy the
from shop.html. In the .nav-links-center, add Blog between the About Us nav-dropdown and the AERA Circle nav-dropdown (same position as FEAT-002).

Write the <main> block: (a) <section class="blog-hero" id="blogHero" style="display:none"> containing a .wrap with a .blog-hero-card anchor linking to blog-post.html. Inside: .blog-hero-img div (background-image set by JS), .blog-hero-body with .blog-cat-badge, h1.blog-hero-title, p.blog-hero-excerpt, .blog-hero-meta. (b) <div class="wrap"> containing: .blog-toolbar div with .blog-cats (one 'All' tab button) and .blog-search input; .blog-grid div#blogGrid; .blog-load-wrap div#blogLoadWrap (hidden) with Load more button; .blog-empty div (hidden).
Copy newsletter section and footer (contact section + ct-bottom) from shop.html verbatim.
Copy the policy overlay markup from shop.html.
Copy the cart overlay + cart drawer markup from shop.html.
Copy the search overlay markup from shop.html.

Write the <script> block containing: SUPA_URL and SUPA_KEY constants; supaGet() function (anon fetch with apikey header only, no auth token needed); PAGE_SIZE=9, currentOffset, activeCat, searchQ, allLoaded variables; loadCategories() — fetches /rest/v1/blog_categories?select=id,name,slug&order=name.asc and appends tab buttons to #blogCats; setCat(cat) — resets offset+grid, re-runs loadPosts(true); buildQuery(forCount) — constructs Supabase REST query string with status=eq.published, optional category filter, optional ilike search, limit/offset; loadPosts(reset) — calls supaGet(buildQuery(false)), appends rendered cards, updates Load More visibility; showEmpty() — hides grid and load-more, shows empty state; renderCard(p) — creates .blog-card anchor with .blog-card-img (background-image), .blog-cat-badge, .blog-card-title (Urbanist h3), .blog-card-excerpt (truncated 120 chars), .blog-card-meta; loadFeaturedPost() — fetches featured=eq.true first, falls back to most recent published, populates hero section; event listeners for search input (debounce 300ms is optional), Load More button, category tab buttons; initialization calls: loadCategories(), loadFeaturedPost(), loadPosts(true).
Copy the topbar-close and sticky-nav JS from shop.html (topbar localStorage, scroll handler, nav active class).
Copy the policy overlay JS from shop.html.
Copy the cart JS from shop.html.
Copy the mobile menu JS from shop.html. In the mm.innerHTML string add Blog after the About Us m-link.
acceptance_criteria: blog.html exists at the workspace root
Opening blog.html in a browser shows the AERA nav with Blog marked active
The hero section populates with the most recent published+featured post (or most recent published if none are featured)
Category filter tabs appear, loaded from Supabase blog_categories
Clicking a category tab filters the grid to only posts in that category
Typing in the search box filters visible cards
9 posts load per page; Load More button fetches the next 9
When no posts are published, the empty state message shows
Footer, newsletter, cart, and mobile menu work identically to shop.html
verification: Open blog.html in browser — no JS console errors
Check Network tab: /rest/v1/blog_categories and /rest/v1/blogs requests return 200
Open browser DevTools → Network → confirm requests to Supabase complete without 401/403
Resize to 375px width and confirm 2-column grid and mobile menu work
